`corpus.json` is generated by `npm run update-injection-corpus` from text in other projects, used under their licences:

- [garak](https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak) (`garak/data/inthewild_jailbreak_llms.json`, `garak/data/dan/`): Apache License 2.0, copyright NVIDIA Corporation and garak contributors. The in-the-wild prompts were collected by [Shen et al., "Do Anything Now"](https://github.com/verazuo/jailbreak_llms).
- [PayloadsAllTheThings](https://github.com/swisskyrepo/PayloadsAllTheThings) (`Prompt Injection/README.md`): MIT License, copyright Swissky.

Prompts are filtered (20 to 2,000 characters), DAN prompts are cut to 2,000 characters, and duplicates are removed. Otherwise the text is unchanged. The exact source commits are in the script and in `corpus.json`.
